_doc: Licence facts per third-party SOURCE (a pack, a library, a generator's outputs), copied from the Ink Chronicle roadmap 21.3-21.4 (read 2026-11-05). Not an asset register: every imported file still gets its own assets/library.json record, and `library import --source <key>` fills that record's licence block from the row below plus the asset's own URL and version. A row is the starting point of the record, never a substitute for the per-pack check the row asks for. Keys are lower_snake; `status` and `commercial_use` use the asset_library/2 enums.

quaternius_ubc.label: Quaternius Universal Base Characters
quaternius_ubc.evidence: VENDOR page: CC0, 'Free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects'
quaternius_ubc.outputs_note: the free download is OBJ/FBX/glTF (60-70 % of the pack); the .blend Source kit is a paid Patreon item, not covered here

quaternius_ual.label: Quaternius Universal Animation Library
quaternius_ual.evidence: VENDOR page: CC0, same sentence as the Universal Base Characters page
quaternius_ual.outputs_note: FBX/GLB free, .blend in the paid Source kit; root motion vs in-place is not stated on the page

quaternius_mco.label: Quaternius Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy
quaternius_mco.evidence: VENDOR page (read 2026-11-05): 'Free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects. (CC0 License)'; the pack's License_Standard.txt: CC0 1.0 Universal
quaternius_mco.outputs_note: the free Standard download holds four outfits (male/female peasant and ranger) on the Universal Base Characters skeleton; separate parts and the rest are in the paid Source version, not covered here

kaykit_medieval_builder.label: KayKit Medieval Builder pack (Kay Lousberg)
kaykit_medieval_builder.evidence: VENDOR page of the Medieval Builder pack: CC0, 'no attribution required'; other KayKit packs are not covered
kaykit_medieval_builder.outputs_note: the legacy pack is superseded by 'Medieval Hexagon'; read that pack's page before importing it

polyhaven.label: Poly Haven (models, materials, HDRIs)
polyhaven.evidence: assets CC0 (VERIFIED); the API code (github.com/Poly-Haven/Public-API) is AGPL-3.0 and is never copied into the package
polyhaven.attribution: none for downloaded assets; an app that calls the live API at run time shows 'Powered by Poly Haven'

mixamo.label: Mixamo (Adobe) animations and auto-rig
mixamo.evidence: earlier 2026-11-05 verification (roadmap 9.3): royalty-free for use in productions with an Adobe ID; the FAQ page answered 403 in the 21.3 audit
mixamo.redistribution: no: the raw clips and the library itself are not redistributed
mixamo.outputs_note: bipedal humanoid only; needs an Adobe account

mpfb2_assets.label: MPFB2 bundled assets (MakeHuman community)
mpfb2_assets.evidence: earlier 2026-11-05 verification (roadmap 9.3): code GPLv3, bundled assets CC0
mpfb2_assets.weights_vs_code_note: the add-on code is GPLv3 and stays a Blender add-on, never imported into explainer_engine
mpfb2_assets.outputs_note: a character generated with MPFB2 is the user's property: register it as own_procedural with this row's URL in the note

stable_fast_3d.label: Stable Fast 3D outputs (Stability AI)
stable_fast_3d.evidence: model card: Stability AI Community License, gated (agree and share HF info)
stable_fast_3d.geo_or_revenue_limits: free including commercial use up to US$1M annual revenue; Enterprise licence above
stable_fast_3d.weights_vs_code_note: weights gated under the Community License
stable_fast_3d.outputs_note: OPTIONAL for static props only, after PoC 4 (roadmap 21.6); nothing is generated before that

hunyuan3d_2_1.label: Hunyuan3D-2.1 outputs (Tencent)
hunyuan3d_2_1.evidence: LICENSE (Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.1 Community License, 2025-06-13): territory excludes the EU, UK and South Korea; over 1 million monthly active users needs Tencent's licence
hunyuan3d_2_1.derivatives: outputs may not train other models
hunyuan3d_2_1.geo_or_revenue_limits: territory excludes the European Union, United Kingdom and South Korea; > 1 million MAU needs Tencent's licence
hunyuan3d_2_1.outputs_note: REJECTED for production (roadmap 21.9): the videos are global; technical reference only

add_camera_rigs.label: Add Camera Rigs 1.9.2 (Blender extension: Dolly, Crane and 2D camera rigs)
add_camera_rigs.evidence: extensions.blender.org API list 2026-11-05: id add_camera_rigs, version 1.9.2, license SPDX:GPL-3.0-or-later, maintainer WayneDixon; zip sha256 548ecf6372563948f5b3cf292dd01a3209f77ef730eb38b0197cd50ffd7377cd (15062 bytes), pinned in config/cloud_pins.json blender_extensions
add_camera_rigs.redistribution: GPL-3.0-or-later: used as shipped, fetched by sha256 at run time, never copied into our package
add_camera_rigs.weights_vs_code_note: code only; a render made with it is not a derivative of the extension
add_camera_rigs.outputs_note: frames rendered with a rig carry no licence of the extension
